question: Estimate the B2B sales opportunity for industrial IoT (IIoT) and Industry 4.0 in India by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: Smart factories + sensor networks + predictive maintenance + connected machinery (Siemens, GE, Tata Elxsi, Indian IIoT startups)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: IIoT spend as % of manufacturing revenue: ~0.5-1% by 2028.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus connected supply chain + warehouse IoT: ~₹5,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: IIoT spend as % of manufacturing revenue
Plus connected supply chain + warehouse IoT

calculationFlow: Of which IIoT-addressable (auto, pharma, electronics, FMCG, metals, machinery): ~₹20 lakh Cr revenue.
Plus connected supply chain + warehouse IoT: ~₹5,000 Cr.
Total Indian IIoT B2B by 2028: ~₹20,000 Cr.
